sourceIdentityPolicy.path: Every sourceEvidence.path is repository-relative as stored in its cited Git commit; a Git ref, when present, is a separate field.
sourceIdentityPolicy.commit: sourceEvidence.commit is the exact Git commit whose tree contains the cited path; sourceBlobOid records that path blob.
sourceIdentityPolicy.documentDate: The Git commit date for sourceEvidence.commit. describedReleaseCommit and describedReleaseDate identify the release being discussed separately.
sourceIdentityPolicy.linesAndExcerpts: Line ranges are 1-indexed and inclusive in the exact commit:path; excerpts are copied verbatim from those lines.
sourceIdentityPolicy.jsonPointers: For JSON evidence, jsonPointers and jsonPointerValues identify values read from the exact commit:path blob; no line range is implied.
sourceIdentityPolicy.attribution: Historical source references do not imply human authorship, approval, or source identity unless the cited artifact states it.
